How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
To get the best result, use Kajabi like a simple system: build your offer, then send people to one clear sales page, then make checkout easy. 
Start with the Foundations steps: validate your idea, set brand colors, add instructor details, build a waitlist, connect a payment method, create your first product, price it, design your website, then test the full purchase journey yourself before you promote it.
Build your sales page on a Kajabi landing page and sell only 1 offer on that page.
On the sales page, focus on the transformation, add testimonials, answer objections, and place clear CTA buttons so people can buy right away. 
On checkout, show a clear offer summary, offer multiple payment options, and include a satisfaction guarantee.
If you use Kajabi Cart, make sure the price is clearly shown (especially if you use custom sections or CTA blocks). 
Reduce cart abandonment by simplifying checkout, showing trust signals, and showing clear pricing. 
Do this first: pick your one offer, then build the single sales page and test buying it yourself.
